name: page-editor-01
title: Page Editor 01
description: A document page (Notion style) with comments beside the text — header with save state and presence, an outline rail, TextEdit with comment highlights, a CommentMargin (or CommentPopover), and a version history sheet with VersionList and DiffView.

meta.whenToUse: A document page with inline comments and version history; compose the same components in your app.
meta.whenNotToUse: A record page with properties and a comments section — use issue-detail-01.
